correctness.rationale: For either functional response, division by the positive states leaves two scalar equations that can be solved pointwise for the two free time-varying rates after arbitrary positive choices of the three interaction constants. Substitution is exact; positivity can be preserved on compact positive trajectories under mild choices, and the compact verification has only roundoff residuals.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. General identifiability theory for time-varying parameters and unknown inputs is established and explicitly excluded from novelty. No located source-specific correction of arXiv:2609.20793v1 gives the displayed gauge families or identifies the failure of the paper's autonomous-to-nonautonomous identifiability inference.

value.rationale: The source uses structural identifiability as a prerequisite for simultaneous recovery of ecological constants and time-varying rates. The exact gauge proves nonuniqueness even under ideal full-state observations and pinpoints what additional information is required to make the inverse problem identifiable.
